description.value: Howe Sound Inn & Brewing is Squamish's original craft brewery, founded in 1996 with the help of John Mitchell, the 'grandfather of micro-brewing,' and named Canadian Brewery of the Year in 2022. The flagship Squamish location operates as a full-service brewpub with a kitchen serving stone-fired pizzas, burgers, and shareables, alongside an on-site inn with pet-friendly rooms. Situated in the heart of Sea to Sky Country at the midpoint between Vancouver and Whistler, it is a natural gathering spot for cyclists travelling the corridor.
